name: MSI Installation From Suspicious Locations
description: Detects MSI package installation from suspicious locations
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: False positives may occur if you allow installation from folders such as the desktop, the public folder or remote shares. A baseline is required before production use.
query: winlog.channel:Application AND ((winlog.provider_name:MsiInstaller AND (event.code:(1040 OR 1042)) AND (winlog.event_data.Data:(*\:\\Windows\\TEMP\\* OR *\\\\* OR *\\Desktop\\* OR *\\PerfLogs\\* OR *\\Users\\Public\\*))) AND (NOT (winlog.event_data.Data:(*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\WinGet\\* OR *C\:\\Windows\\TEMP\\UpdHealthTools.msi*))))
